title: HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to authorizing the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles (HACLA) to use Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) funds for…
text:
[Council File 26-1465]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to authorizing the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles (HACLA) to use Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) funds for resident services programs at various HACLA public housing developments for Calendar Years 2027 through 2029.
Recommendation for Council action:
AUTHORIZE the HACLA to use PILOT funds for resident services programs for Calendar Years 2027 through 2029, including youth employment, public safety infrastructure, digital literacy and access, enriched recreation and education programming for youth, and recreation center improvements, as detailed in HACLA report dated October 12, 2026, attached to Council file.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the HACLA. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
